result.title: MitoWorld: A Stochastic World Model of the Single-Cell Cycle under Genetic Perturbation
result.summary: A cell observed after a gene knockdown has an uncertain future, both in how its appearance will evolve and when it will divide. Existing approaches predict endpoints or population-level changes without jointly modeling individual trajectories and division timing. In this work, we present MitoWorld, a stochastic world model that generates these future appearances as continuous evolution in a Gaussian reference latent, terminated by a division hazard and converted into images by a conditional diffusion renderer. The ordinary transition provably preserves its Gaussian reference, tying its noise to its dynamics; paired observations identify its discrete transition where stationary marginals cannot. The hazard turns division timing into a survival likelihood that can be tested against real cycle lengths. On 325 held-out MitoCheck tracks spanning 17 knockdowns and a control, MitoWorld lowers FID by 34.6\% and the video metric JEDi by 45.6\% relative to the strongest baselines. Its latent-space prediction intervals achieve near-nominal 90\% coverage, are 35\% narrower than those of a model with freely fitted noise. The hazard also yields cell-cycle length distributions with KS distance close to the model-based finite-sample reference. Testable single-cell stochastic dynamics thus offer a generative tool for time-lapse perturbation screens.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 MitoWorld，一个面向基因敲低后单细胞周期轨迹的随机世界模型：在高斯参考 latent 中生成连续演化状态，以分裂 hazard 终止轨迹，再由条件扩散渲染器转成图像，并在 MitoCheck 数据上报告 FID、JEDi 与 latent 预测区间的覆盖表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「hazard 终止 + 保持高斯参考的 latent 转移」可能为 LVR 的停止决策与 latent 状态不确定性校准提供一种可核查的建模范式，但属细胞影像领域，与 VLM 推理仅有概念层联系，需较多核查。
